implementation: KC API using AES-NI for AES core and CLMUL for GHASH
description: Ubuntu Kernel Crypto API cryptographic module provides cryptographic services to the software components executing as part of the Linux kernel. This test covers the implementations of gcm_base(ctr-aes-aesni,ghash-clmulni), ccm_base(ctr-aes-aesni,aes-aesni), cbc(aes-aesni), ecb(aes-aesni), xts(aes-aesni), kw(aes-aesni), and cmac(aes-aesni).

oes.name: Ubuntu 16.04 on Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2620v3
